name: Four Seasons Resort & Residences Cartagena
positioning: Hotel in the Getsemaní neighbourhood, on the doorstep of Cartagena’s Walled City, set partly in restored heritage buildings
best_for: Travelers who want a base on the doorstep of the Walled City
Guests who like having eight restaurants and lounges on site

facts.text: The hotel is at Media Luna 8B #8B-44, Getsemaní, Cartagena de Indias.
The hotel is in the neighbourhood of Getsemaní, right on the doorstep of the Walled City.
The hotel has eight restaurants and lounges.
The Grand Grill is a steakhouse set within Club Cartagena.
Pizzeria della Chiesa serves pizza and pasta.
The hotel has a rooftop with two swimming pools.
UMARI spa has six treatment rooms.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
Premium Wi-Fi is listed among the hotel’s complimentary services.
The airport is a 15-minute drive from the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel includes restored heritage buildings such as Club Cartagena and the historic San Francisco Cloister and Temple.
The Premier Room is the hotel’s largest contemporary guest room.
The rooftop pools have 360-degree views of the modern cityscape and the historic Walled City.
El Aljibe is a speakeasy that once served as a water reservoir.
UMARI spa has a couples’ suite.

considerations.text: UMARI spa is open every day from 10:00 am to 7:00 pm.
WhataHotel notes an urban setting within the historic district rather than beachfront.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
